health.title: Health note
health.body1: Manta offers gentle movements, but it doesn't replace a doctor or a physiotherapist.
health.body2: Always move without pain. If something hurts, stop and breathe.
health.body3: If you have an injury, recent surgery, dizziness or blood pressure problems, check with a health professional first.
health.body4: On a boat or anywhere that moves, practice seated or keep something to hold on to nearby.
